title: rig stack manifest
description: A fused stackspace of upstream forks: each repo's history imported under a prefix of one git history through josh's reversible filters. See docs/STACK-DESIGN.md.

josh.description: josh engine version tag this stackspace pins (e.g. r26.07.19). Defaults to the version pinned in rig. Changing it against existing stackspace history is at your own risk.

branchPrefix.description: Prepended to the name `rig stack send` is given, so `send lib read-timeout` creates stack/read-timeout. Defaults to "stack/"; set to "" for bare names. A repo entry may override it.

repos.description: One entry per fused project; the key is the prefix directory its history lives under.

upstream.description: Canonical repo. PRs land here. Written as host/owner/name; an https or ssh URL you pasted is accepted and reduced to that.

fork.description: Your fork. `rig stack send` pushes extracted branches here. Written as host/owner/name; an https or ssh URL you pasted is accepted and reduced to that.

owned.description: This project is yours, not someone else's. Enables `rig stack push`, which fast-forwards its own branch with the stackspace's commits and their history, instead of `rig stack send`, which proposes one squashed commit to a fork.

upstreamBranch.description: Branch of `upstream` this directory follows — what `pull` takes and what `send` roots on. Defaults to main. Not the branch `send` creates; you name that per change.

upstreamTag.description: Pins this directory to a tag of `upstream` instead of following a branch. `pull` has nothing to do until you edit the pin. Use it when your consumer depends on an older release than upstream's tip.

upstreamCommit.description: Pins this directory to an exact commit of `upstream`. Must be the full 40-character SHA — an abbreviation cannot be resolved without fetching the repo first.

branch.description: Deprecated name for upstreamBranch. Still read; prefer upstreamBranch, which cannot be confused with the branch `send` creates.

branchPrefix.description: Overrides the stackspace branchPrefix for this project. Set to "" to send bare names to this fork only.

lastSync.description: Written by import and pull, not by hand: the full upstream commit each repo was last taken from.

additionalProperties.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. An abbreviated one never matches the remote tip.

lastPin.description: Written by import and pull, not by hand: which pin each repo's cursor was resolved under, so a tag that upstream moves can be told apart from one you repinned.

lastPropose.description: Written by `rig stack propose`, not by hand: the branch name each repo was last proposed on, offered back next time so an open pull request can take another round without retyping it.
